posts.author: TwoPlyGaming
posts.body:
Hello. I've had plenty of issues with RPG Maker MV for a while now, perhaps since a windows update? Not sure. Anyway, one issue I'm dealing with is tilesets not... loading? When I open MV, sometimes one or more tilesets show as completely transparent in the editor. They may or may not reappear when closing and opening MV again. For example, in the picture below, my A2 and A4 tilesets have shown as transparent. They appear just fine when opening the playtest.
Again, this can seemingly only be fixed by reloading MV one or more times and just getting lucky that the tilesets load properly. Verifying the integrity of the files, reinstalling, 4gb patch, and many more fixes have been tried. Seemingly nobody else has encountered or talked about this. I hope whatever fix is easy because I have been agonizing over very frequent crashes that I finally might've overcome. Any help is greatly appreciated. Thanks.

posts.author: KaijuuKimi
posts.body: Weird indeed. Maybe you can try changing to older version like 1.6.2 for a while and see if the issue persist?
